plans.idea: Left-aligned editorial stack that reads top to bottom: logo, then a large headline and subhead sharing one left edge, then a large centered bottle filling the lower half, so the bottom of the canvas isn't left empty.
Centered poster on one vertical axis: the brand mark at top center, the bottle large in the middle as the visual anchor, and the headline and subhead set wide below it.
Diagonal layout that echoes the original's copy-left, bottle-right balance: logo and a narrower text block wrapping to a bigger 3-line headline in the top-left, the bottle large in the bottom-right.
